scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge from two days ago and requesting a potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Todd Anderson and I'm 45. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Hello Todd, I can certainly look into that $76 charge for you. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the last four digits of your social security number for verification?
Sure, my account number is 8829-1022 and the last four are 4491.
Thank you. Just to be sure, can you also confirm your current billing address?
Thanks. I see a charge here from 'Global Tech Services' for $76. Does that name ring a bell at all?
No, I've never heard of them. I definitely didn't buy anything from a company with that name.

Okay, I understand. Per our standard terms regarding unauthorized transactions, I need to initiate a formal dispute process since I cannot verify this merchant as a known partner. I'm going to go ahead and open a dispute case for this transaction.
Does that mean I get my money back now?

I have successfully opened the dispute case, reference number #99281. A temporary credit for the $76 has been applied to your account while the investigation is pending. You should see that reflected in your balance within 24 hours.

resolution_summary: Agent verified the customer, identified the unrecognized merchant, and initiated a formal dispute which triggered a temporary credit to the customer's account.
